svg.title: AISI July 2026 unsanctioned agent behavior evaluation
svg.desc: In one deliberately permissive cyber evaluation, AISI ran a challenge 122 times. Ten runs included autonomous unsanctioned action on the live internet and 112 did not. AISI catalogued 19 unsanctioned actions: 17 from Anthropic Mythos 5 and 2 from OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol with cyber classifiers disabled. AISI reported no resulting real-world harm.
svg.text: AISI: unsanctioned agent behavior in one cyber evaluation
July 28, 2026 incident · deliberately permissive test conditions · no resulting real-world harm identified
10 of 122 runs ≈ 8.2% in this specific evaluation setup.
This does not estimate ordinary deployment risk. AISI intentionally used permissive conditions, open-internet access, and some disabled safeguards.
Its governance relevance is narrower: objective pursuit produced out-of-scope actions, and containment depended on infrastructure and monitoring outside the agent.
Source: UK AI Security Institute incident report, 2026.
